title: Operation Shadow
notes: Start > New Game > Single Player offers the Tutorial and the Ixan campaign.
Briefing text advances with key 5 or the left soft key, not with OK.
You fight on foot and in a Humvee, a tank and a helicopter; key 2 enters or leaves a vehicle. Options > Controls in the game shows the keys for each.
The right soft key pauses the game.
N-Gage Arena and the Bluetooth multiplayer are not available in the browser.

controls.source: The game's four diagrams under Options > Controls (Infantry, Humvee, Tank, Chopper). The keypad drawing is small, so the positions were checked in play as infantry: forward, turning, grenade (7), mission status (9), fire (5) and both soft keys were seen working; strafing (4, 6), change weapon (3), enter or exit vehicle (2) and the vehicle rows are as read from the diagrams. The year is from general knowledge of the game.

actions.4: Strafe left (on foot, chopper); turret left (tank)
actions.5: Machine gun (on foot, Humvee, chopper); missiles (tank); next briefing text
actions.6: Strafe right (on foot, chopper); turret right (tank)

notes: Third-person layout: W and S (or the up and down arrows) move, the left and right arrows turn, A and D strafe. Space fires, G throws a grenade, E enters or leaves a vehicle, R changes weapon and M shows the mission status. Esc pauses.

On a gamepad the left stick moves and turns and the right stick strafes; RT fires, LT throws a grenade, X enters or leaves a vehicle, Y changes weapon, Back shows the mission status, and B or Start pauses. RT or LB also moves the briefing text on.

statusNote: Logos, title, menus and the control diagrams work, and the Tutorial campaign loads into the 3D world: after the instructor's briefing the soldier walks, turns, throws grenades, and the mission status and pause screens open.

enhance.note: The ground and the models (soldiers) are captured; the sky backdrop, trees and the HUD are left to the game. The ground's blend between kinds of ground and its lighting are approximated. Needs the emulator's paletteStride.
